prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: American Board of Orthodontics certification search
engine_stated_criteria: How many Invisalign/braces cases like mine do you treat each year?
What is included in the quoted fee?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist in Miami—especially because the right choice differs for a simple cosmetic Invisalign case versus complex bite correction, impacted teeth, or jaw issues.

For most people, the best starting point is an **orthodontist (not just a general dentist) who is board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics** and has substantial experience with your preferred treatment.

Use these directories to find Miami-area candidates:

- **American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) locator:** https://aaoinfo.org/find-an-orthodontist/  
- **American Board of Orthodontics certification search:** https://www.americanboardortho.com/  
- **Invisalign provider locator:** https://www.invisalign.com/find-a-doctor  

When comparing offices, book 2–3 complimentary consultations and ask:

1. **Are you a board-certified orthodontist?**
2. **Will the orthodontist personally plan and monitor my treatment?**
3. **How many Invisalign/braces cases like mine do you treat each year?**
4. **What is included in the quoted fee?** Ask about retainers, refinements, X-rays, broken brackets, missed visits, and transfer fees.
5. **Would braces produce a better result than aligners for my bite?** A good orthodontist will be candid rather than pushing Invisalign for every case.
6. **Can I see before-and-after cases similar to mine?**

For a complex overbite, underbite, crossbite, significant crowding, or teen treatment, prioritize an orthodontist with strong braces and interdisciplinary/surgical-case experience. For a straightforward adult alignment case, an experienced Invisalign orthodontist with good follow-up availability may be ideal.

If you tell me your neighborhood in Miami (e.g., Brickell, Coral Gables, Kendall, Miami Beach, Doral, Aventura) and whether this is for an adult or child, I can help you narrow down what to look for and compare specific local offices.
